continuity: Final Rally is active: it greatly reduces Taekyung’s pain, temporarily greatly increases his Qi Sense, and lets Scorching Yang Qi heal some of his Internal Injuries; the sudden quest has a nine-minute-59-second limit, with five minutes remaining at chapter’s end.

plot: Jin Taekyung awakens under Final Rally, which suppresses his pain, heightens his Qi Sense, and lets Jeok Cheongang’s Scorching Yang Qi heal some of his injuries. With a nine-minute-59-second quest timer, Taekyung fights forward alongside Jeok Cheongang, Cheongpung, the Saints, and civilians who charge to protect him. He remembers fallen companions and loved ones, including Hyuk Mujin, whom he believes is dead, then shatters two Black Ghosts’ Force attacks. The Slaughter Saint and Bow Saint engage the Black Ghosts, whose wounds and severed limbs keep regenerating under overlapping magic. Taekyung advances with Jeok Cheongang and Cheongpung and confronts the Blood Lord; the quest timer shows five minutes remaining.
translation_decisions: Render 회광반조 as “Final Rally,” consistent with the established glossary; retain “Black Ghost” for 흑귀 and “Force” for 강기.
Render the sudden quest title 바람 앞의 촛불, 혹은 불꽃 as “A Candle in the Wind, or a Flame.”
